title: The Forest Brothers
episode: Forest Brothers - anti-Soviet Guerilla War in the Baltics - THE COLD WAR
place: Museum of Occupations and Freedom Fights
description: On the Forest Brothers, guerrillas who fought Soviet rule from the Baltic forests for years after 1944. Many captured fighters were interrogated and shot in the KGB building in Vilnius, now the Museum of Occupations and Freedom Fights.

title: When Vilnius was Wilno
description: How Poland and newly independent Lithuania fought over Vilnius after the First World War. Polish troops seized it in 1920, and it stayed Polish until 1939. Józef Piłsudski, Poland’s leader, had his heart buried in Rasos Cemetery.
